text:
Zoe CSM: Quick flag for QBR — account ORIONX shows a sharp rise in embedding token burn over the last 36h. Need a compact slide: short root cause, 3-tier forecast, and immediate mitigations we can propose in the renewal packet.

Mark (FinOps): On it. Ill run baseline / trend / surge scenarios and recommend a credits cushion. Send me last 60d and current commit.

Priya (Enablement): I'll prepare a 1-slide engineer-friendly checklist (batching, dedupe, prefix cache, dim-reduction) and a tiny code snippet for quick adoption.

Anil Eng: Infra peek shows the spike from a new background worker hitting /v1/embeds/bulk without the batching header. Lots of tiny parallel calls. I can put a temporary concurrency cap and tag requests missing batch-size.

alert-bot: Billing alert: ORIONX reached 78% of monthly token allocation. AlertID: a-7723

Zoe CSM: Action items: 1) Mark  forecast + cushion rec by 14:30. 2) Anil  short-term cap + telemetry tag, ETA 20m. 3) Priya  checklist + snippet by EOD. I'll draft customer outreach offering a 30-min remediation call and propose a temporary soft throttle.

Mark (FinOps): Quick numbers: 30d_tokens=1,020,000; 7d_tokens=410,000; monthly_commit=1,200,000. Projections if trend holds: baseline ~1.2M, likely ~1.7M, worst ~2.6M. Recommend a 20% cushion for renewal and a 60% soft-throttle trigger until mitigation is applied.

Anil Eng: Deployed concurrency cap of 12 on /v1/embeds/bulk and added telemetry to flag missing batch headers. Monitoring now.

Priya (Enablement): Draft checklist: set batching header, max_batch_size=128, normalize+dedupe inputs, enable KV prefix caching, sample low-value items. Node snippet:
```
// set batch header
client.options.defaultBatchSize = 128
const inputs = dedupe(inputs)
await client.embeds.create({input: inputs})
```

Zoe CSM: Mark  can you add an estimated savings line assuming batching yields 2.5x token reduction on the top 3 routes? I'll include that in the QBR "cost mitigation" slide.

Mark (FinOps): With 2.5x reduction on top routes, projected month falls to ~940k (under commit). I'll add a before/after chart and sensitivity table (5/15/30% uplifts).

alert-bot: Billing alert acknowledged: trending down after cap.

Zoe CSM: Great work. I'll post the customer note in #customer-comm for review and schedule the remediation call. Priya, include the checklist in the QBR appendix. If alerts spike again, I'll escalate. :white_check_mark:
